chunks: Yunus, from 'Abd Allah ibn Sinan, said:
I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about two men, each of whom falsely accused the other. He said: "The hadd punishment is averted from both of them, and they are both given ta'zir."

key_terms.افْتَرَى: falsely accused or fabricated a slanderous claim
key_terms.رَجُلَيْنِ: two men involved in the case
key_terms.يُعَزَّرَانِ: the two are given discretionary disciplinary punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling when two people falsely accuse each other in Shi'a fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning two individuals who each make a false accusation against the other. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that the fixed hadd punishment is waived in such a case, while both parties are subject to discretionary punishment.
